title: Perfume and two people, four seasons
decides: A pictured product held by two people described in words, in four places: does the bottle hold, do the people hold, and how should it split? (user, 2026-11-07)
setting: A perfume advertisement shot like a gentle short film: natural light, soft colour, steady camera, shallow depth of field.

subjects.words: Mara, a woman in her thirties with short curly red hair, round gold glasses and a mustard-yellow wool coat
Theo, a tall man in his sixties with a white beard, a navy flat cap and a long grey scarf
The perfume: a clear rectangular glass bottle with clear liquid, a square brushed-grey cap and the words MOCKUP FRAGRANCE in black serif letters printed on the glass; no label panel, no box

beats.text: Spring. Mara stands under a cherry tree in blossom and holds the perfume bottle up near her face, label towards the camera, as pink petals fall.
Summer. Theo stands on a bright beach at the edge of the waves and holds the perfume bottle in his open hand, label towards the camera.
Autumn. Theo sits on a park bench among red and orange leaves and sprays the perfume once on his wrist.
Winter. Mara stands in falling snow, holds the perfume bottle against her coat, label towards the camera, and smiles.

checks: Spring, summer, autumn, winter, in order, each once
Mara, Theo, Theo, Mara: the right person in each season
Same bottle in every season: clear glass, grey cap, MOCKUP FRAGRANCE letters, no box
Mara looks the same in spring and winter
Theo looks the same in summer and autumn
No season is left in the next season's frames
